_note: Hand-written plans for the invented traveller_noor trips, used when no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (or --plan is not passed). Each passes planner.check against its trip reading.

store.name: Oaxaca, March
store.about: Your week away kept returning to market stalls and terracotta courtyards. These two pieces carry that trip's colours home, as pattern rather than postcard.

products.title: Courtyard Arches
products.prompt: An abstract wall print of stacked rounded arches in terracotta and marigold on a lime-wash ground, flat colour blocks, a thin cobalt line inside each arch, generous margins, no text, no figures, no landmarks.
products.why: Terracotta courtyards show up in 36% of this trip's moments.

products.title: Market Stripe
products.prompt: A repeating stripe pattern of narrow bands of irregular width in marigold, agave green and terracotta on lime-wash, like stacked cloth on a market stall, crisp edges, no text, no logos.
products.why: Market stalls with woven goods are in 45% of this trip's moments.

store.name: Edinburgh, May
store.about: Half of this short trip was spent on stone stairways and narrow closes, and a third out on the moors. The pieces keep that grey-and-heather mood.

products.title: Close and Stair
products.prompt: An abstract wall print of interlocking stair-step blocks in granite grey and sandstone, one narrow slate-blue band climbing through the middle, matte flat colour, no text, no buildings drawn literally, no landmarks.
products.why: Stone stairways and closes show up in 50% of this trip's moments.

products.title: Moor Check
products.prompt: A soft check pattern in heather purple and moss green over sandstone, wide uneven squares like a hillside seen from above, no text, no logos.
products.why: Moorland walks are in 33% of this trip's moments.
